stories.title: Stock market rocked as investors dump tech shares; Nasdaq suffers worst day since June: Live updates

The Nasdaq Composite tumbled on Friday, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average outperformed as traders moved out of key stocks related to artificial intelligence and into more defensive areas of the market. stories.title: Intel stock has worst day since 1970s, wiping about $12 billion off government's stake
stories.summary: Intel shares fell 29% on Friday and headed for their worst day since the 1970s. The chipmaker issued weaker-than-expected guidance, citing ongoing softness in the PC market. Amazon also sold off following an earnings miss.
